retention_policy.strong_domain_rule: If one or more strong domains exist, retain all strong domains.
retention_policy.supported_only_rule: If no strong domains exist but supported domains exist, retain only supported domains with the highest routing score.
retention_policy.supported_exact_tie_rule: If multiple supported domains share the exact highest routing score, retain all tied top domains.
retention_policy.tentative_rule: Tentative domains may be returned as routing evidence but cannot generate career candidates.
retention_policy.no_evidence_rule: If no supported or strong domain exists, generate no career candidates.

routing_score_semantics: Weighted domain compatibility evidence derived from the domain skill map. It is not a probability, readiness score, or final career recommendation score.
candidate_generation_semantics: Candidate careers are generated from retained domains using career taxonomy primary and secondary domain membership. Candidate generation is routing only and does not rank careers.
tie_semantics: Exact supported-domain evidence ties are preserved rather than broken arbitrarily.
